name: sidekick
description: A second opinion inside Claude Code from the model you choose: OpenRouter (Grok, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, GPT, Claude, Gemini and more) or Google Gemini directly. Review, debug, architect, brainstorm. Run /sidekick:setup after installing.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Paste your key right on this line (no separate prompt opens), then press Enter to save. Get one at openrouter.ai/settings/keys. One key reaches Grok, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, GPT, Claude, Gemini and more. Stored in your system keychain.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Paste your key right on this line (no separate prompt opens), then press Enter to save. Get a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey. Stored in your system keychain. Leave blank if you only use OpenRouter, Google Cloud Agent Platform, or a shell-exported key.

service_account_file.title: Service-account key file
service_account_file.description: Only for Google Cloud Agent Platform with a service account: pick its JSON key file. Leave blank for an API key or gcloud login.
